thread:
incident-bot: PAGER: elevated 502/504 and timeouts for /v1/generate in prod-us-east-1. Error rate ~22% over last 5m. Pager -> karen-oncall :rotating_light:

karen-oncall: Taking this. Is there a recent deploy?

mike-sre: No deploys in the last hour. Gateway shows surge of 502s upstreaming to model-runners. Starting tail on gateway logs.

jin-eng: Seeing repeated OOM/segfault in model-runner logs for model: redwood-gpt-13b-quant on worker pool pool-03. Sample: ```[2026-03-17T02:04:12Z] model-runner[pid=2345]: segfault at 0x7f2c... backtrace: quant_attention_kernel +0x1b3```

raj-runtime: Confirmed. Telemetry: kernel OOMs correlate with requests having long context (>2048 tokens) and concurrent KVCACHE growth. KV cache memory spikes then eviction then crash. CPU/GPU mem graphs: https://internal/graphs/edge/1798680246 (link)

anne-support: Two enterprise customers reported increased failures: acme-inc (error rate 37% for /v1/generate), beta-retail (20% failures). Support triage opened: https://tickets/internal/ACME-1122

karen-oncall: Immediate mitigation plan: 1) route traffic away from pool-03 to healthy pools, 2) roll model->fallback smaller quant or non-quant variant for long-context requests, 3) scale up runner-pool as band-aid. Can someone run route change?

mike-sre: Routing change in progress: `infractl route update --route /v1/generate --avoid-pool pool-03 --reason \"OOM spike\"` -> pushed. Monitoring for error rate drop.

jin-eng: Preparing guarded hotfix: disable quant attention optimization for redwood-gpt-13b-quant on pool-03 and restart runners. Patch: `CONFIG_DISABLE_QUANT_ATTENTION=1 systemctl restart model-runner` — need approval to restart pods (brief traffic blip).

karen-oncall: Approve restart. We already routed traffic off pool-03. Keep me posted.

mike-sre: Reroute completed. Error rate dropped to 6% in 2m, latency improved. Continuing to watch.

raj-runtime: Hotfix applied to 3/4 nodes in pool-03. One node stuck in crash loop during restart (OOM at boot). Collecting dmesg / system logs.

jin-eng: Crash-loop node shows kernel OOM while loading quant kernels. Creating evict+recreate job for that node. Moving critical customer traffic to dedicated fallback routes for acme-inc.

anne-support: Notifying acme-inc point of contact: sent update that our mitigation reduced failures and we're doing targeted restarts. They asked for ETA; please provide <30m if possible.

alex-product: Any customer data loss? Need to assess if any requests retried or failed mid-token.

mike-sre: No persisted data impacted. Failures are request-level 5xx/timeouts. We'll surface a post-incident summary.

karen-oncall: Handoff: mike-sre will own until stable, jin-eng and raj-runtime for runtime fixes, anne-support to coordinate customer comms. If error rate climbs >10% re-pager.

mike-sre: Remaining action items: 1) drain and recreate crash-loop node, 2) run full KVCACHE mem cap on pool-03, 3) schedule follow-up to add guardrail for long-context requests (reject > 4096 tokens until fix). Tracking in #incidents-1798680246.

jin-eng: Root cause hypothesis: recent quant attention micro-optim that reduces memory checks allowed KVCACHE to grow past kernel boundaries under certain prompt shapes -> segmentation faults. Will prepare revert PR and regression test harness for long sequences.

anne-support: Acme-inc notified. They accepted mitigation and asked for incident postmortem and ETA on permanent fix.

mike-sre: Error rate stabilized ~3% for last 10m. Marking incident as mitigated; continuing watch and will escalate if changes.

incident-bot: Incident updated: status=mitigated, lead=mike-sre, severity=sev2, link=https://incidents/internal/1798680246
